goal: Prove that a bounded Build Colony Work Package can execute on an independent GitHub-hosted runner and return transport-bound evidence without granting remote project authority.
invariants: The remote conformance runner is read-only with respect to repository state.
The remote runner may transport execution evidence but cannot verify or integrate its own work.
No repository secret or private signing key is required by the transport probe.
The returned receipt must remain bound to the exact GitHub run, trigger revision, Work Package, session dispatch, result envelope, and ledger head.
forbidden_actions: execute arbitrary commands supplied by the remote intent
treat GitHub provider metadata as a cryptographic actor signature
self-verify or self-integrate the returned result

domains.objective: Execute the Build Colony test suite on an independent GitHub-hosted runner and return a receipt bound to the exact remote run and Work Package.

gates.description: Independent GitHub-hosted execution evidence with run and artifact bindings
